parity.description: Parity setting: N=none, E=even, O=odd, M=mark, S=space

force_reset.description: Force pyserial to reset device parameters

endtime.description: End program after specified seconds (float allowed)

command.description: Command string to send to serial port before reading

time.description: Print relative time for each line (relative to base time)

systime.description: Print absolute system time for each line

launchtime.description: Set base time from program launch

match.description: Regex pattern to define base time for relative timestamps

instantpat.description: Regex pattern whose timestamp should be printed at end of run

quitpat.description: Regex pattern that, when matched, causes program to exit

output.description: File path to which output will be written
